summary: Frontend-only regression of the three static login pages (gateway.html, cel_bricks.html, cel_credit.html) on the public preview URL at 1920x800. All 3 pages fully verified via Playwright reading real DOM state (el.disabled, getComputedStyle().display, aria-checked). 17/17 functional assertions passed: gateway email validation (#emailError block/none), clickable verification widget (#ccCaptcha aria-checked=true + #ccTick display block after ~1s), 3-condition Entrar gating (disabled on load, stays disabled with only email / email+password, enables only after captcha, re-disables when password cleared), overlay #ccLoadingOverlay display=flex after submit; cel_bricks submit disabled on load, invalid email keeps it disabled and shows #emailError, valid email+password enables it, password-toggle switches type password->text->password, #loadingOverlay flex on submit; cel_credit submit disabled on load, plain username 'meu_usuario' + password enables it (no email format required), re-disables when username cleared, #ccLoadingOverlay flex on submit, header img[alt=Celcoin] loads (500x145). Overlays keep spinning by design (not treated as a defect). No console errors on any page. Backend testing skipped per request.

issues: 4 elements have naturalWidth=0 (broken). One of them is laid out at 338px wide over the left cel_payments illustration and renders a visible browser broken-image icon/border in the top-left of the artwork. Their src values are sanitized/truncated data URIs (e.g. "data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27#" and "data:,"), so the inline SVG payloads were stripped when the page was saved. Cosmetic only.

Header img[alt=Celcoin] has naturalWidth=500 but getBoundingClientRect().width=0, so the top header strip renders as an empty white band (~95px tall). Logo is effectively invisible on this page (it renders fine on cel_credit.html).

action_items: gateway.html (cosmetic, optional): restore/replace the 4 stripped data-URI images - at least the 338px one that shows a broken-image icon over the left illustration.
gateway.html (cosmetic, optional): give the header Celcoin logo a non-zero rendered width so the top header band is not blank.
critical_code_review_comments: All three pages are single self-contained saved-HTML files with inline minified CSS/JS (very large); functionally fine for a static mock but not maintainable - validation/gating logic is duplicated in three places and could be extracted to one shared script if these pages evolve.

Interactive elements are addressed by id/class only; no data-testid attributes exist. Tests currently rely on ids (#email, #username, #password, #ccCaptcha, form button[type=submit]) which are stable, so no change was made.
test_credentials: Not applicable - no backend auth; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for these static pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigate directly to /gateway.html, /cel_bricks.html, /cel_credit.html (static files in /app/frontend/public, not React routes). Read button state with el.disabled and overlays with getComputedStyle(el).display - do NOT rely on class names. Wait ~1200ms after clicking #ccCaptcha before asserting aria-checked/#ccTick. Loading overlays spin forever by design; stop the test after asserting display=flex. Only outstanding findings are cosmetic broken images / zero-width header logo on gateway.html.
rca_of_the_issue: Broken images on gateway.html: the page was saved from a live site and several inline data-URI images were truncated to "data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27#" / "data:,", so the browser fails to decode them (naturalWidth=0) and paints the default broken-image glyph where the element still occupies layout space (338px). Purely presentational; no impact on validation, gating, or submit behaviour.
